_note: THE CURATED HALF of the settings schema. Hand-written, and the only hand-written half.
The generated half is two mirrors -- Config.cpp's 79 plugin keys (scripts/lib/configkeys.py)
and Hyprland's 353 options (config/schema/hyprland-descriptions.json) -- and neither of them
knows what a pane is or how a value is applied. That is what this file adds, and it adds it as
DATA: a pane list, a route table, and per-key overrides. A new option is a row here, never a new
QML file. scripts/gen_schema.py joins the three into docs/schema.json, which is what the app reads.
APPLY STRATEGIES, and why `live` is not one of them for a durable write:
preview   hyprctl keyword -- INSTANT and TEMPORARY. Phase 10 measured both halves of why:
a live write is discarded by the next `hyprctl reload` (and theme-sync reloads on
every wallpaper change), and it lands LAST so it would beat a pin, which is the one
ordering guarantee the fragment layer has. So it drives the slider and nothing else.
reload    the durable write: fragment.py rewrites the pane's machine half, then hyprctl reload
re-parses the whole chain -- which is what re-applies pin > derived > default.
qs-restart  ii's config.json; quickshell reloads itself, no compositor involvement.
monitor   like reload, but through the keep-these-settings countdown (scripts/hdmon.py).
wallpaper the rice's own rotation script, which regenerates the palette and fans out.

plugin:hyprdrive:blur.note: The overview WALLPAPER backdrop -- the single documented exception to frost-everywhere (user, 2026-08-01: the cards are sharp, the frost goes on the strip cells instead). It is a toggle here because the user made it one.

plugin:hyprdrive:dock:background_opacity.note: Clamped at 0.45 by theme-sync as well: the pill's frost is compositor blur sampled through it, and an opaque surface has no backdrop to blur.

decoration:blur:enabled.locked: Frost is on, everywhere -- the user's standing product rule. This is not a casual toggle. To turn compositor blur off anyway, type `decoration = { blur = { enabled = false } }` into the raw-snippet editor below: the raw block is deliberate, a switch is not.

debug:overlay.locked: Wedges this guest's compositor (recorded in the campaign brief). Read-only on purpose.

extra.description: The wallpaper. Setting it runs the rice's own rotation, which regenerates ii's matugen palette -- which is what makes the accents follow (Phase 10). A video path is handed to mpvpaper and the palette comes from a frame of it.
Regenerate the palette when the wallpaper changes (THEME=1). Off swaps the image and leaves every accent where it is.

Which repository the pane browses and the slideshow walks. A repository is a directory: add a path for a local one, a git URL to clone a remote one. The list is not a schema choice because it is data -- the pane fills this dropdown from `hdwall repos`.

Off is one wallpaper until you change it. Ordered walks the repository in name order; random picks another one each time. Both re-derive the palette if wallpaper.theme is on, so the whole desktop follows the slideshow.
Minutes between slideshow changes. The timer wakes once a minute and reads this, so a change takes effect immediately and nothing has to be restarted.
illogical-impulse's own translucency for bar and panels.
How much of the wallpaper the shell's own backgrounds let through.
The same, for content layers on top of them.
Tint the shell's surfaces with the palette.
Rounded screen corners drawn by the shell. 0 off, 1 always, 2 when not fullscreen.
Which Material scheme matugen derives from the wallpaper. Changes every accent the dock and overview inherit.
Fan the wallpaper's palette out to apps and the shell. Off freezes the whole adoption chain.
Stop drawing the desktop widgets behind a fullscreen window.
